description: We built Rotawise, an open source crop rotation advisor for Nigerian smallholder farmers. It reads NASA HLS imagery to recover each plot's season history since 2020, scores soil fatigue with SoilGrids soil data, tests rotations against NASA POWER climate records and NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 projections for the 2040s, prices fertilizer savings in naira and delivers advice in Hausa or English on any phone via USSD. Live at https://rotawise-five.vercel.app
